email_sign_in_code_body:
Your sign-in code is:

{code}

It is valid for {minutes} minutes and can be used once. Enter it on the page where you asked for it.

If you did not ask for this code, you can ignore this email: nobody can sign in without it.
email_registration_not_open_body:
Someone asked to sign in with this email address, but there is no account for it, and the archive is not open to new registrations at the moment. No account was created.

If you did not ask, you can ignore this email.
email_suspension_body:
Your account has been suspended. You cannot sign in until the Suspension is lifted.

Reason given:

{reason}

What you created before stays as it is: your drafts and the Submissions waiting for review are kept, and contributions already approved are unchanged.

To contest this decision, reply to this email: your reply reaches the archive's contact for these matters. You can also go to court.
email_new_address_code_subject: Code to confirm your new email address
email_new_address_code_body:
Someone asked to use this address for their account in the archive. To confirm the change, enter this code on the Account page:

{code}

It is valid for {minutes} minutes and can be used once.

If you did not ask for this change, you can ignore this email: the address is not changed without the code.
email_address_in_use_subject: This address already has an account
email_address_in_use_body:
Someone asked to move another account of the archive to this email address, but this address already has an account. Nothing was changed, and no code was sent.

If it was you, sign in with this address instead. If you did not ask, you can ignore this email.
email_email_changed_subject: Your email address has been changed
email_email_changed_body:
The email address of your account has been changed to {masked_email}. From now on, sign-in codes and emails go to the new address.

If you did not make this change, write to {privacy_contact} to contest it.
